title: Published in the 1980s
statementMd:
List books published from 1980 to 1989 inclusive.

Expected columns: `title`, `published_year`.

Tables: `authors`, `books`, `members`, `loans`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT title, published_year FROM books WHERE published_year BETWEEN 1980 AND 1989;
```
